cold_email.subject: Interest in Math Content Teacher — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Think Academy U.S Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Math Content Teacher opportunity with Think Academy U.S at Think Academy U.S.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Learning Operations Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Sandisk Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Learning Operations Specialist opportunity with Sandisk at Sandisk.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Human Resources Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pyramid Global Hospitality Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Human Resources Coordinator opportunity with Pyramid Global Hospitality at Pyramid Global Hospitality.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Administrative Assistant — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear OhioHealth Rehabilitation Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Administrative Assistant opportunity with OhioHealth Rehabilitation Hospital at OhioHealth Rehabilitation Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Lab Technician I — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Massachusetts General Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Lab Technician I opportunity with Massachusetts General Hospital at Massachusetts General Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Long - Term Substitute Teacher - Humanities — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear High Tech High Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Long - Term Substitute Teacher - Humanities opportunity with High Tech High at High Tech High.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Conservation Education Program Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Guy Harvey Foundation Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Conservation Education Program Coordinator opportunity with Guy Harvey Foundation at Guy Harvey Foundation.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Technician I Job Details / Charles River Laboratories, Inc. — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Charles River Laboratories Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Technician I Job Details / Charles River Laboratories, Inc. opportunity with Charles River Laboratories at Charles River Laboratories.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Representative — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Quality Lab Technician (Aerospace - Plastic Mfg.) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Airtech International Inc. Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Quality Lab Technician (Aerospace - Plastic Mfg.) opportunity with Airtech International Inc. at Airtech International Inc..

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, our purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that transform patients' lives. Central to this mission is our Research and Development team, which strives to convert advanced science and cutting-edge technologies into impactful therapies and vaccines. Whether you are engaged in discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy, or supporting clinical trials, your role is crucial. You will leverage innovative design and process development capabilities to expedite the delivery of top tier medicines to patients globally. By integrating advanced scientific knowledge with practical applications, we aim to bring the most effective treatments to those in need, fulfilling our commitment to improving health outcomes worldwide. What You Will Achieve As an Associate Scientist, you will perform molecular diagnostic assays including PCR and DNA/RNA isolation within a regulated, high‑throughput laboratory environment to support vaccine efficacy studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality data in a compliant manner according to relevant Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and Good Clinical Laboratory Practice (GCLP) guidelines. You will work within a team where roles and responsibilities are shared across group members. Effective collaboration is essential to achieve team goals. Ability to communicate results, adapt to changing priorities, and recognize when to seek guidance is required. How You Will Achieve Perform PCR & nucleic acid isolation, handle clinical samples including nasal swabs, stool, tissue biopsies, or blood/serum inside a biosafety cabinet, and interact with laboratory automation including liquid handlers, and programmable pipettes. Run molecular diagnostic assays strictly adhering to SOPs. Perform routine equipment maintenance including verification of liquid handler dispense volumes, monthly lab inspections, cleaning, and archiving data. Execute protocols to qualify equipment, record results in real time and prepare summary reports. Collaborate with group members to perform assigned tasks. Use Microsoft Excel, Teams, Outlook, and other efficiency tools to gather and communicate data, track inventory, order lab supplies. Calculate sample concentrations, prepare buffers and related solutions. Perform sample preparation for molecular assays to support clinical studies. Create reagent or sample aliquots appropriate for use with automated processes. Present experimental results at group and project meetings. Write progress reports or create PowerPoint slides describing results. Perform job responsibilities in compliance with GCLP and all other regulatory agency requirements. Stay current on departmental and corporate training. Perform other tasks as assigned. Qualifications Must-Have BS or equivalent in a relevant scientific discipline (immunology, microbiology, genetics) and 0-2 years of experience working in a laboratory setting. Understanding of molecular biology and PCR. Knowledge of aseptic technique. Knowledge of laboratory automation. Experience working in a regulated environment highly desired. Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate and work in team environment. Has a good foundation in general scientific practice and in the principles and concepts of a relevant scientific discipline. Possess basic math and laboratory skills. Strong oral and written communication skills. Proficiency in the use of Word processing, Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant scientific undefined Nice-to-Have Strong problem-solving skills & excellent communication skills Ability to work independently and as part of a team Strong organizational skills Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance workflows. PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS This position requires the typical physical demands of a general scientific laboratory environment during set up and operation of pharmaceutical laboratory equipment. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS This position may require occasional weekend work hours, as necessary. Individuals will be required to adhere to safe work practices including the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Work Location Assignment: On Premise The annual base salary for this position ranges from $60,200.00 to $100,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 7.5% of the base salary. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer. U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future. Sunshine Act Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative. EEO & Employment Eligibility Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States. Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com . This is to be used solely for accommodation requests with respect to the accessibility of our website, online application process and/or interviewing. Requests for any other reason will not be returned. cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Scientist, Clinical Immunology & Diagnostics — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Scientist, Clinical Immunology & Diagnostics opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Staff Bioinformatics Scientist
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. The DRAGEN Bioinformatics team develops industry-leading secondary analysis solutions for DNA and RNA NGS applications used by researchers and clinicians worldwide. Our team builds high-performance, scalable algorithms and software for transcriptomics, oncology, population genomics, and multiomic analysis. We leverage advanced computational methods, machine learning, artificial intelligence, foundation models, and cloud technologies to transform genomic data into actionable insights. We are seeking a Staff Bioinformatics Scientist with deep expertise in transcriptomics, computational biology, and bioinformatics software development to help advance the next generation of DRAGEN analysis solutions. The successful candidate will combine biological insight with strong algorithmic, statistical, and software engineering skills, and will provide technical leadership and product development experience across multiple product cycles. Responsibilities Lead development of novel algorithms and analytical methods for RNA and multiomic sequencing applications. Design, evaluate, and implement scalable bioinformatics algorithms and methods for bulk RNA-seq, single-cell sequencing, CRISPR/Perturb-seq analysis, ATAC-seq, CROP-seq, and emerging multiomic assays. Apply machine learning, AI-based methods, foundation models, LLM-enabled workflows, and biological foundation models to accelerate method development, validation, interpretation, and product innovation. Develop production-quality software solutions in collaboration with bioinformatics scientists, software engineers, FPGA engineers, assay development teams, and product teams. Lead technical projects, define requirements, influence product direction, evaluate risks, and drive innovation across multiple product cycles. Mentor scientists and engineers and contribute to scientific and technical leadership within the organization. Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for new features, products, analytical capabilities, and intellectual property. Required Qualifications Degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Statistics, Biology, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. Significant experience developing DNA/RNA bioinformatics algorithms, analytical methods, and production software for NGS applications, such as genome alignment. transcript expression, calling fusions and splice variants in RNA, and calling small and large (structural, CNV) in DNA Strong background in genomics, transcriptomics and biological data analysis. Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C++, Python, or similar. Experience designing, validating, benchmarking, and interpreting computational methods for complex biological datasets. Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to independently drive complex projects from concept to product delivery. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and technical strategy. Track record of innovation through publications, patents, invention disclosures, open-source contributions, or commercial product development. Preferred Qualifications Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience; or equivalent experience. Experience with bulk RNA-seq, gene expression analysis, alternative splicing, gene fusion detection, and RNA biomarker development. Experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or modern data science techniques to biological data analysis, method development, or software validation. Experience with single-cell genomics and transcriptomics workflows. Experience with CRISPR/Perturb-seq analysis, CROP-seq, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, CROP-seq, or other multiomic assays. Experience using AI-assisted software development and scientific analysis tools to accelerate method development, testing, validation, or interpretation. Experience with cloud computing, distributed computing, or large-scale genomic data processing. Knowledge of oncology, clinical genomics, population genomics, translational research, or biotechnology product development. #LI-REMOTE The estimated base salary range for the Staff Bioinformatics Scientist role based in the United States of America is: $155,600 - $233,400. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off. We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected or the requisition has a sufficient number of qualified applicants. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

cold_email.subject: Interest in Staff Bioinformatics Scientist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Staff Bioinformatics Scientist opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in the lab's use of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data to connect molecular mechanisms with therapeutic questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built reproducible genomics workflows and enjoy translating complex biological questions into clear, testable computational analyses.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Digital Products & Experiences Operations Associate
jobs.location: United States - New York - New York City
jobs.description: Digital Products & Experiences Operations Associate Role Summary The Digital Product & Experience Operations Associate plays a critical role in keeping DPX’s product work organized, on track, and moving. Reporting to the Head of Product Operations, this role is the delivery-coordination backbone for the team: maintaining the plans, logs, and reporting the team relies on, and supporting the Product and Strategy leads across the product lifecycle. It is a hands-on role for an early-career contributor who wants to learn the discipline of digital product delivery inside a regulated environment by being genuinely useful, not by observing. Role Responsibilities Own scheduling and logistics for assigned workstreams: maintain accurate project plans, track milestones, flag timeline risks early, and keep owners aligned on what is due and when. Maintain a live RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) for assigned projects: surface new entries proactively, track mitigation actions, and escalate blockers to the functional lead or Operations before they affect delivery. Track action items across workstreams: follow up with owners, flag items at risk of missing deadlines, and maintain a single source of truth the team can trust. Contribute to status reporting: draft weekly or sprint-level status updates that accurately reflect progress, outstanding decisions, and upcoming milestones, written for a stakeholder audience rather than just the internal team. Facilitate recurring team meetings: prepare agendas in advance, capture decisions and action items, and distribute clear follow-up notes with owners and due dates within 24 hours. Support intake and scoping for new requests: document requirements, confirm resourcing and timing with relevant leads, and ensure new work enters the right workflow with clear ownership before execution begins. Support change control: document scope changes, assess timeline and resourcing impact with the functional lead, and ensure adjustments are communicated and recorded before execution shifts. Maintain project documentation in the appropriate tools (Smartsheet, Jira, or equivalent), keeping plans, logs, and trackers current so the team spends its time on the work, not on reconstructing where things stand. Support the Product and Strategy leads across the product lifecycle, contributing to requirements and roadmap development, competitor and market research, and launch coordination. Collaborate with Digital, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, Medical, and Marketing through design, development, QA, MLR, and release. Basic Qualifications Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with 0+ years of experience; OR an associate's degree with 4 years of experience; OR a high school diploma (or equivalent) and 6 years of relevant experience 0-2 years in product, operations, program coordination, or a related role, with a track record of keeping complex work organized and on schedule. Strong organizational and project-coordination skills, with demonstrated ability to maintain plans, logs, and trackers others can rely on. Clear, stakeholder-ready written communication, particularly status reporting and meeting documentation. A human-centered mindset, with an interest in the end customer and how digital products serve them. Courage to flag risks and surface issues early, including to senior stakeholders. Strong writing, presentation, and influencing skills. Discretion and trustworthiness in dealing with confidential information. Role model for the PFE Values (Courage, Excellence, Equity, Joy). Preferred Qualifications Experience in health tech, regulated environments, or pharmaceutical/life sciences organizations. Exposure to AI tools, prompt engineering, or automation workflows, either professionally or through independent learning. Background or demonstrated interest in UX research, product strategy, or innovation methodologies. Working knowledge of Agile values, principles, and practices. Comfort with project and work-management tools (e.g. Smartsheet, Jira) and an appetite to use AI-enabled tools to work faster. Additional Job Information: Last Date to Apply: September 11, 2026 Work Location Assignment: Hybrid The annual base salary for this position ranges from $60,200.00 to $100,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 7.5% of the base salary. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer. U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. cold_email.subject: Interest in Digital Products & Experiences Operations Associate — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Digital Products & Experiences Operations Associate opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 1
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. The Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 1 is an integral member of the Manufacturing Equipment Engineering technical track, providing technical support for Illumina's manufacturing equipment, instrumentation, and production operations at the San Diego headquarters. This role supports equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, calibrations, supplier support, and continuous improvement activities in a fast-paced, regulated manufacturing environment. Working under established procedures and engineering guidance, the Equipment Engineer 1 applies foundational knowledge of optical, mechanical, electrical, fluidics, computer hardware/software, and instrument control systems to help sustain equipment availability and reduce recurring equipment issues. This individual collaborates with engineers, operations, vendors, and cross-functional partners to support safe, compliant, reliable, and sustainable manufacturing execution. Responsibilities: Demonstrates the ability to complete tasks independently with minimal supervision, effectively reporting and tracking progress through a digital ticketing system. Appropriately escalates issues to engineers or supervisors and engages in troubleshooting under guidance. Independently plans, coordinates, and executes multiple concurrent activities—including calibrations, preventive maintenance, repairs, supplier support, and project work—following established instructions to ensure timely completion as directed by the supervisor. Supports the development, execution, and continuous improvement of preventive maintenance procedures to improve manufacturing equipment availability and reliability. Assists engineers in troubleshooting and reducing recurring or systematic equipment failures using structured problem-solving methods, equipment data, maintenance history, and ticketing-system trends. Supports installation, qualification, startup, and modification activities for manufacturing equipment and instrumentation under engineering guidance. Partners with vendors, engineers, operations, and cross-functional teams to resolve equipment issues, improve supportability, and sustain production readiness. Assists in monitoring technical performance of equipment and managing spares inventory within assigned areas of responsibility. Provides support for computer hardware and software procedures as well as troubleshooting efforts. Collaborates within a team environment to enhance equipment reliability, safety, compliance, and continuous improvement. While performing required duties, this position routinely involves standing, sitting, walking, climbing stairs or ladders, kneeling, crouching, and wearing safety gear. The role regularly requires lifting and/or moving up to 10 pounds, frequently lifting/moving up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lifting/moving up to 50 pounds. Requirements: Typically requires 0 to 2 years of previous professional experience. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities Proficient in computer and Microsoft Office applications Skilled in data collection techniques with strong hands-on capabilities Experience working within high-volume manufacturing environments and spare parts utilized in manufacturing equipment Familiarity with optical, mechanical, electrical, and/or fluidic systems Proficient in interpreting electrical and mechanical schematics Experienced in using engineering troubleshooting tools and structured problem-solving methods Foundational knowledge of equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, calibration, repair, and spares-management practices Familiarity with internal instrument communication and control interfaces, such as PLC/IO, RS232, sensors, and related control systems, where applicable Good mathematical and analytical skills Good verbal and written communication skills in English Mechanical aptitude Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Good Documentation Practice (GDP) Ability to work a flexible schedule or rotational shifts, including weekends Willingness to travel up to 10% Previous experience in the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Medical Devices industries is advantageous Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs. The estimated base salary range for the Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 1 role based in the United States of America is: $68,400 - $102,600. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off. We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. cold_email.subject: Interest in Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 1 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Manufacturing Equipment Engineer 1 opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Continuous Skills Development Trainer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Walmart Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Continuous Skills Development Trainer opportunity with Walmart at Walmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027. As a Data Engineer Intern within the Platform product group, you'll partner with analytics engineering to build and maintain the data pipelines and infrastructure that power insights across Coinbase. You'll work alongside senior engineers and cross-functional partners in product and engineering to ensure data accuracy, scalability, and accessibility for analytical and machine learning use cases. What you'll do: Build and maintain data pipelines that ensure data integrity and accessibility for analytics and machine learning workloads Support the development of scalable data infrastructure using Python and cloud-based technologies Integrate and manage data from multiple sources, including internal systems and external APIs Contribute to analytical deep dives with senior team members, translating findings into clear documentation and recommendations Learn and apply data engineering best practices including data governance, security, and performance optimization Required Skills and Experience: Completed or in-progress coursework in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent experience with demonstrated programming proficiency in Python, including data structures and algorithms Hands-on experience writing SQL for data analysis and working with relational database concepts Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and a demonstrated interest in AI, LLMs, or API integrations Exposure to software architecture concepts such as microservices, distributed systems, or cloud-native design through coursework or projects Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Req ID: P78146 #LI-Hybrid Pay Transparency Notice: Depending on your work location, the target hourly rate for this position can range as detailed below. Hourly Rate: $50 — $50 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. cold_email.subject: Interest in University Graduate - Software Development Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear 🔥 Adobe Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the University Graduate - Software Development Engineer opportunity with 🔥 Adobe at 🔥 Adobe.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Community team builds relationships with credible power users, helps them do something consequential with OpenAI’s technology, and turns the strongest outcomes into stories people remember and retell. ABOUT THE ROLE OpenAI is seeking a founding Program Lead to build a fellowship connecting exceptional new graduates with small and medium-sized businesses seeking practical support adopting AI. Small businesses need hands-on help adopting AI. New graduates need credible pathways into the AI economy. We are looking for someone who can create concrete value—and find inspiring stories that cut through the noise—by connecting the two. This new program will recruit and train technically capable graduates, match them with businesses, and support them in deploying OpenAI tools against real operational needs. Its goals are to help these businesses achieve measurable value, create meaningful career pathways in AI deployment for new grad, and surface credible stories about how AI can benefit everyday organizations and communities. You will take the program from concept to launch—testing demand, shaping the service model, recruiting the founding team and first fellows, and building the systems required to operate responsibly and scale. This is a zero-to-one leadership role for someone who combines entrepreneurial judgment with strong field and operational experience. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Drive the strategy and build the team and partners to realize, then scale, this program. - Identify the businesses, markets, and operational needs best suited to the program. Build a strong pipeline of SMB partners and establish clear readiness criteria. - Develop a repeatable methodology for understanding business needs, deploying OpenAI tools, and enabling teams to use them independently. - Design the full fellow experience, from selection and training through deployment support and career development. - Establish standards for responsible deployment, including privacy, security, system access, quality, and escalation. - Define meaningful measures of business impact, product adoption, and fellow development. - Build feedback loops that turn early deployments into a scalable operating model. - Partner across OpenAI—including Product, GTM, Research, Global Affairs, Legal, Security, Communications, and Marketing. - Pinpoint and work with our creative teams to capture authentic, consent-based stories grounded in strong participant outcomes. - Develop a thoughtful path toward additional markets and a broader profession of AI deployment specialists. jobs.title: Staff Bioinformatics Scientist
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. Position Summary: Designs, models, and develops data management systems that integrate laboratory, operation and research data. Designs, builds, improves and maintains high performance and highly scalable data pipelines. Oversees transition of data pipelines to production and commercial settings; develops technology choices and practices that support pipeline maturation. Researches and assesses the viability of new data management and processing technologies. Scope of Responsibilities: Applies subject matter expertise and extensive knowledge of theories, practices, and design matters to lead the application of existing principles and guide the development of new ideas. Provides, guides, and uses professional concepts to resolve critical issues. Works on highly complex assignments that address future concepts where problem solving requires conceptual thinking and an evaluation of enigmatic components. Accountable for results which may impact multiple functions. Enhances formal networks with key decision makers and recognized as a thought leader to several diverse stakeholders. Exercises wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches to critical assignments. Mentors others and effectively leads team activities. Exercises wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches to complex assignments. Solutions are devised based on limited information and requires judgment. Experience/Education: Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience; or equivalent experience. #LI-REMOTE The estimated base salary range for the Staff Bioinformatics Scientist role based in the United States of America is: $155,600 - $233,400. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off. We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. cold_email.subject: Interest in Staff Bioinformatics Scientist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Staff Bioinformatics Scientist opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer 2
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. The Equipment Engineer 2 is responsible for the sustainment, troubleshooting, reliability, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing equipment used in Flow Cell Manufacturing. Working closely with Manufacturing Operations, Engineering, and key partners (e.g., Quality, Validation, Facilities, R&D), this role supports assigned equipment systems and subsystems while contributing to initiatives that enhance safety, quality, yield, reliability, and manufacturing efficiency. This is a highly hands-on engineering role that balances manufacturing floor support with equipment analysis, technical documentation, and continuous improvement activities. Significant time is spent troubleshooting equipment, supporting production operations, investigating failures, and implementing equipment improvements. Working with appropriate technical oversight, the Equipment Engineer 2 plans and executes activities within assigned areas of responsibility, including ownership of equipment subsystems or components of larger manufacturing systems. The role also develops technical documentation, performs equipment performance analysis, supports training and knowledge-sharing activities, and contributes to continuous improvement efforts. Technical findings, project updates, and recommendations are communicated through reports and presentations. Responsibilities Support manufacturing operations through equipment troubleshooting, sustainment, technical problem solving, and engineering improvements while owning assigned equipment subsystems or components of larger manufacturing systems with appropriate oversight. Develop and continuously improve preventive maintenance, calibration, repair, and equipment reliability programs, including procedures, work instructions, technical documentation, and training materials. Independently troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, controls, automation, robotics, and process-related issues using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis methods, recognizing when to engage senior engineers, management, or subject matter experts for particularly complex challenges. Support and troubleshoot automated manufacturing equipment, including industrial controls, robotics, machine vision, motion control, and related automation technologies. Use electrical schematics and diagnostic tools to troubleshoot electrical control systems, instrumentation, automation systems, and equipment failures. Collect, analyze, and interpret equipment performance data, maintenance records, and MMS information to identify failure trends, evaluate equipment health, and improve reliability, availability, and uptime. Support investigations by providing equipment-specific analysis, contributing to root cause determination, and implementing corrective actions within assigned equipment areas. Support equipment installation, integration, qualification, and readiness activities. Partner with internal and external stakeholders to support reliability initiatives and component, spare-parts, or vendor selections within assigned areas. Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience. Technical Skills: Strong mechanical and electrical/electronics troubleshooting skills demonstrated through experience supporting automated equipment and manufacturing systems. Working knowledge of automated manufacturing systems, including PLCs, industrial controls, robotics, machine vision, motion control, servo systems, instrumentation, sensors, industrial communications, vacuum systems, chillers, pneumatic systems, and HMI/SCADA platforms. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical drawings, pneumatic diagrams, PLC logic, and technical documentation. Experience using common measurement, inspection, and troubleshooting tools, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, gauges, and similar diagnostic equipment. Experience analyzing equipment or process data to support troubleshooting, SPC, trend analysis, and reliability improvements; familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, JMP, Minitab, or similar analytical tools is preferred. Understanding of safe work practices when working with mechanical, electrical, laboratory, manufacturing, automation, laser, or chemical systems. Professional Skills: Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and structured problem-solving skills with the ability to independently diagnose and resolve equipment-related issues within assigned areas of responsibility. Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical observations, findings, and project updates to manufacturing and engineering teams. Ability to plan and prioritize assigned activities with minimal guidance while balancing manufacturing support, equipment sustainment, reliability improvements, documentation, and project commitments. Ability to provide technical recommendations based on equipment performance, analysis, and operational data. Comfortable balancing hands-on equipment support with analysis, documentation, and continuous improvement activities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Preferred Qualifications: Flexibility to support manufacturing schedules outside the traditional Monday-Friday workweek, including fixed five-day schedules (e.g., Sunday-Thursday or Tuesday-Saturday). Experience supporting automated manufacturing equipment within semiconductor, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, GMP-regulated manufacturing, or other highly automated production environments. Experience with industrial automation and equipment-support technologies, including PLCs, robotics, machine vision, motion control, HMI/SCADA platforms, industrial communication protocols (e.g., EtherCAT or EtherNet/IP), vacuum systems, chillers, pneumatic systems, and MMS/CMMS. Familiarity with Beckhoff PLCs, Cognex In-Sight vision systems, or similar manufacturing automation technologies is preferred. Experience supporting equipment installation, integration, qualification, reliability initiatives, continuous improvement projects, supplier interactions, and manufacturing support activities. Listed responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Responsibilities may change based on business needs and organizational priorities. The estimated base salary range for the Equipment Engineer 2 role based in the United States of America is: $82,500 - $123,700. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Placement depends on experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off. We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. To learn more, visit: https://www.dol.gov/ofccp/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/eeopost.pdf. The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected or the requisition has a sufficient number of qualified applicants. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
